scope: Trainable parameters of the JSED Q-Mixer model reported in the manuscript. Optimizer state, gradients, non-trainable buffers, input data, and preprocessing artifacts are excluded.
counting_rule: sum(parameter.numel() for parameter in model.parameters() if parameter.requires_grad)
public_model_relationship: This value does not describe any of the four public D=512 entry points. Those entry points are counted by tools/count_parameters.py and have separate configuration-dependent totals.

verification.reason: The JSED data and its private model implementation are not included in this repository. A scalar total cannot reconstruct layer names, tensor shapes, bottleneck width, depth, discriminator inclusion, FLOPs, or latency.
minimum_release_needed: versioned model source or an executable reviewer-only archive
per-layer parameter names, tensor shapes, and trainable flags
model configuration including input feature width, D, depth, and classifier/discriminator scope
checkpoint SHA-256 and the exact software commit
latency device, batch size, warm-up, repetition count, and timing code

reviewer_note: The public code does not need to contain the literal number 22600 for a reviewer or an automated checker to identify a contradiction: parameter counts follow directly from visible layer dimensions. The correct remedy is to separate the private JSED claim from public D=512 configurations and release the manifest or executable private implementation needed to verify it.
